name: Puddle
author: Erin Carter
description: Dark wet asphalt carved by puddle patches that hold wobbling vertical smears of unseen neon — columns of palette colour stretched downward by a domain-warped reflection. The smears wobble slowly as the warp drifts, and hash-timed drips drop single expanding rings that bend the reflections for a second before fading.

params.label: Wobble
params.effect: Amplitude of the reflections' side-to-side warping, from mirror-still water to restless wind-shaken smears.

params.label: Drip rate
params.effect: Frequency of drip rings breaking the puddles; 0 means still air, 2 keeps rings landing every couple of seconds.

params.label: Smear width
params.effect: Width in CSS pixels of the reflected neon columns, from thin distant signs to broad close-up signage washes.
